changelog:
- Initial release of `oo-hasdata` for using HasData through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Runs HasData actions via the `oo` CLI with server-side credential injection.
- Supports public web page scraping with `scrape_web`.
- Supports synchronous Google SERP searches with `search_google_serp`.
- Includes schema-first guidance, JSON execution examples, safety notes, and first-time setup troubleshooting.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@0fdcf2d`
summary: HasData (hasdata.com). Use this skill for ANY HasData request — searching and reading data. Whenever a task involves HasData, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
